proposal.explanation: The simulation mismatches show o_data stuck at 0 when it should carry valid payload values (65, 253, 184, 143, 121). The highest-relevance candidates directly substitute the correct data signals (i_data or w_data/r_data) into the o_data combinational assignments where 0 is currently driven. patch_1f207853dea8 and patch_e9c2e7485e9b target the NET_OUTPUT combinational path; patch_97ba2adecc6f targets the REG_OUTPUT sequential path. The condition_gate candidates adjust r_valid control logic around reset and valid qualification, which may fix the valid/ready handshake that gates data flow, but they do not directly supply data to o_data and show lower structural coverage of the failure site.

ranking.mechanism: rhs_substitution on o_data assignment in NET_OUTPUT: replace constant 0 with i_data when r_valid is false and low-power/invalid conditions apply
rhs_substitution on o_data assignment in REG_OUTPUT: replace constant 0 with w_data (which carries r_data) when r_valid is false
rhs_substitution on o_data assignment in NET_OUTPUT: replace constant 0 with w_data (r_data) when r_valid is false and low-power/invalid conditions apply
condition_gate on r_valid initial block: qualify reset with i_valid so r_valid is not cleared during valid input
condition_gate on r_valid set condition: add i_reset check to prevent r_valid being set during reset
condition_gate on r_valid initial block: qualify OPT_INITIAL with i_valid
condition_gate on r_valid initial block: qualify reset with !o_ready
condition_gate on r_valid initial block: qualify OPT_INITIAL with i_reset
